title: Power Display Profile Switch linked to Light Switch not triggering during wake from sleep
author: milanmp
summary: Light Switch can apply the correct theme after wake or startup without invoking the linked Power Display profile, while manual theme changes invoke it correctly.
next_action: Approve resume/startup reconciliation for linked Power Display profiles.

confidence.rationale: The missing resume/startup event path is strongly isolated, but timing with monitor enumeration still needs targeted validation.

judgment.rationale: Three reports show that Light Switch updates the theme after sleep or power-on but the linked Power Display profile is not reconciled. Manual theme switching does trigger the profile, isolating the missing path to resume/startup state synchronization.
evidence: The original issue includes deterministic night-to-day sleep/wake steps and a diagnostic archive.
Manual Light Switch theme changes trigger the linked profile correctly.
Two independent confirmations cover monitor sleep and full power-off/on.
Duplicate #50083 was closed after automated triage linked it to this canonical issue.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve resume/startup reconciliation for linked Power Display profiles.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing fix attempt covers the scoped PowerToys-owned path identified by this lightweight judgment.

proposed_fixes.title: Reconcile linked Power Display profiles after resume and startup
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The Light Switch-to-Power Display integration applies profiles on live theme-change events but does not re-evaluate the linkage when the desired theme changes while the display or machine is asleep.
plan: On resume/startup, wait for monitor enumeration and Light Switch mode to stabilize.
Compare the active Power Display profile with the profile linked to the current theme and apply only when they differ.
Debounce duplicate power/theme notifications and log the reconciliation decision.
verification: Sleep before a scheduled light/dark transition, wake afterward, and verify the linked profile applies.
Repeat across monitor sleep, system sleep, restart, manual theme changes, and multiple monitors.

confidence.rationale: The missing resume/startup event path is strongly isolated, but timing with monitor enumeration still needs targeted validation.

issue_context.summary: Light Switch can apply the correct theme after wake or startup without invoking the linked Power Display profile, while manual theme changes invoke it correctly.
known_information: The issue affects scheduled Night Light/Light Switch transitions that occur while the machine or monitor sleeps.
Power Display profile linkage is enabled.
The profile applies during a manual light/dark switch.
The bug also occurs after power-off/on according to a confirmer.
inferences: The integration listens to live theme-change notifications but does not reconcile desired profile state on resume or startup.
The fix should be idempotent to avoid unnecessary monitor writes on every wake.
issue_context.analysis: The difference between manual switching and resume establishes a clear missing lifecycle event. A bounded design can reconcile the current Light Switch mode and selected Power Display profile after resume/startup.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full live body, attached diagnostic reference, all confirmations, timeline, and duplicate #50083.
Confirmed #50083 was closed as a duplicate rather than as a separate fix.

actions.label: Reproduce missed resume profile switch
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact does not execute the steps or write upstream.

reproduce.version_requirement: Latest stable or Preview PowerToys build
prerequisites: Create distinct light and dark Power Display profiles
Schedule a theme transition while the display or machine is asleep
steps: Start in the dark profile before the scheduled daylight transition.
Put the monitor or machine to sleep across the transition.
Wake it and record the active Windows theme and Power Display profile.
Manually toggle the theme and compare whether the profile then applies.
reproduce.expected_result: Wake/startup applies the profile linked to the current theme once monitor enumeration is ready, matching manual switching.
